This creates a conflict with the test_search_request test, which suggests either the docstring or test may be incorrect, but per your instructions, that's not the agent's responsibility to change.

The boolean handling (true/false) and quote vs quote_plus changes are correct. The alphabetical sorting should be removed to align with the docstring requirement.
